problem_statement: Fix summarize_transactions() so it groups valid transactions by category and returns one {category, net} object per category in first-seen order. Each row has a nonnegative integer amount and kind sale or refund; refunds subtract from the net. Rows without category are ignored. A present category is a nonempty string, and even a zero-amount row introduces it. Retain categories whose final net is zero and return [] for no categorized rows.
